evidence.title: AI Surrogate Modeling for Real-Time Tokamak Equilibrium Prediction: Benchmarking Neural Architectures and Validation on EXL-50U

summary: Researchers benchmarked neural architectures for AI-driven surrogate modeling to predict tokamak plasma equilibria in real time, validating performance on the EXL-50U experimental device. The study demonstrates potential for enhancing fusion reactor control systems.
title: AI Surrogate Models Accelerate Real-Time Tokamak Equilibrium Prediction in EXL-50U Tests
